headline: Why is the Leapmotor B10 succeeding in Spain?: Latest-generation safety and range, the keys to its successful July
summary: The Leapmotor B10 was the best-selling 100% electric vehicle in Spain in July, according to the report. The article highlights its safety and range as reasons for its performance.
why: Leapmotor is a Chinese electric vehicle maker, and sales in key European markets indicate its competitive position against established automakers.
